rationale: This is a substantive rather than cosmetic modification of the archive's best-performing signal — adding back current R&D removes a genuine double-penalty against research spending while retaining the intangible-augmented capital base — though reviewers should note it lands close to published intangible-capitalized profitability measures (Peters–Taylor / Eisfeldt–Papanikolaou style) and inherits the same ~5% coverage limitation.

The second leg and MIN structure are literally identical to the archived "Research-Earnings Joint Floor" (which delivered fmb 2.80 but a negligible ls_alpha of 0.016 and ls_talpha 1.42), so this amounts to swapping one R&D-intensity proxy for another within an already-tested and portfolio-weak construction rather than addressing why the cross-sectional slope failed to translate into alpha.

This is structurally the same "rising intangible/goodwill share plus deteriorating profitability" bet as the archived "Intangible Buildout Cash Divergence" (fmb -1.00, ls_alpha 0.001) with ib substituted for oancf, and the goodwill-growth leg is largely a repackaging of the well-documented acquirer-underperformance and asset-growth anomalies.

The joint-change construction is genuinely distinct from the level-based intangible signals already in the archive and the expression matches the stated hypothesis, but the maturity-mismatch story is loose — the current-liability growth leg is essentially operating-liability growth, a known accrual-family predictor, so a positive result may be a rediscovery in disguise.

The two legs are mechanically redundant — amortization of identifiable intangibles flows directly into dp, so conditioning high intan-gdwl/at on high dp/sale is close to double-sorting on the same quantity — and the resulting construct is a near-relabel of the archived "Unproductive Identifiable Intangibles" with a weaker economic rationale for the negative sign (capital-intensive high-D&A firms are not obviously overvalued).

This is the sign-mirrored twin of the archived "Unproductive Identifiable Intangibles" (same intangible leg, profitability condition simply inverted), and given the MIN structure the spread will be dominated by the standard margin-floor/profitability anomaly rather than by anything intangible-specific.
